input.change_text: Added `includeGitInstructions` setting (and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS` env var) to remove built-in commit and PR workflow instructions from Claude's system prompt

output.subject: includeGitInstructions setting to drop built-in git/PR system prompt
output.action_text: Set `includeGitInstructions: false` in settings.json (or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS=1`) to strip the built-in commit and PR workflow guidance from Claude's system prompt. Useful when you maintain your own git instructions in CLAUDE.md; default behavior unchanged.
